decision_basis: declared after V2 scores and V3 feature distributions, before any sequence or deep-model score
windows: the same V2 code windows as V3 (assignment3/cache/windows_v3.parquet keys)

sequence.grid: index = floor((Time - window start) / 4 ms); at most one sample per step, extra samples counted (amended, see amendments)
sequence.missing: steps without a sample are 0 in every channel, so holes are never compressed
sequence.A_seq_with_position: x / 1920 and y / 1080, absolute screen position
sequence.B_seq_without_absolute_position: x and y minus their window mean over present samples, then / 1920 and / 1080
sequence.pupil: standardised with mean/SD of present samples from training people only, then missing steps reset to 0

architecture: 3 blocks of Conv1d(same padding) + BatchNorm + ReLU, MaxPool(2) after blocks 1-2; channels f, 2f, 2f; global average pool; dropout 0.3; linear to 2 classes

fixed.loss: cross-entropy with balanced class weights from training windows

early_stopping: inner validation equal-participant balanced accuracy, checked every epoch; first best epoch wins ties
selection: pooled inner out-of-fold equal-participant balanced accuracy at each fold's best epoch; first configuration wins exact ties
selection_caveat: inner scores are optimistic because the same inner validation people also stop training; the outer validation people are never used
refit: all outer-training people for the median best epoch of the selected configuration

seeds.reporting: metrics use seed 42; seeds 43-44 only report refit spread

transfer.interpretation: transfer learning: pretrain the CNN on a related source task, then fine-tune on vehicle/rectangle
transfer.source_task: instruction screen (calibration or comprehension instructions) vs answer screen (multiple-choice), from the same recordings
transfer.source_windows: 2 s windows anchored at raw screen messages with the V1 coverage/gap rules and the V2 >=80% measured rule
transfer.source_people: only the training people of the current partition: inner-training people for inner CV, outer-training people for the refit; never validation or locked-test people
transfer.source_training: same architecture as the scratch CNN selected in that outer fold and feature group; 30 epochs; balanced class weights; seed 42

modes.freeze: convolution and batch-norm layers fixed, new head trained at learning rate 0.001
modes.finetune: all layers trained at learning rate 0.0003 from the pretrained weights

transfer.comparison: transfer vs the same scratch CNN, on both sequence groups, same outer folds

amendments: 2026-11-02, before any sequence or deep-model score: the declared +2 ms rounding put a window's last sample on step 500 whenever the sample phase exceeded 2 ms. Floor indexing is always in range for half-open windows; collisions are counted instead of assumed absent.
timing: wall time for each refit; prediction timed in 5 warm batches of the outer validation set; trainable parameter count

justification.why_cnn: 1D convolutions learn local temporal patterns (fixations, saccades, blinks) directly from the preprocessed samples, which the assignment allows
justification.filters: capacity; 16 vs 32 tests whether more feature maps help with about 600 training windows
justification.kernel_size: first-layer span of 20, 36 or 60 ms brackets saccade durations; after pooling, the last block spans roughly one fixation-saccade cycle
justification.fixed_choices: Adam at 0.001 and batch 32 are standard defaults; early stopping and dropout limit overfitting on a small dataset
justification.B_centering: removing each window's mean position mirrors feature group B: relative movement stays, absolute screen location goes
justification.source_task_choice: it uses the same eye tracker, people and reading behaviour, but its label is unrelated to which program is shown
